# Coding With Mohit

> Mohit Kumar Mishra (Coding With Mohit / CWM) is a full stack developer based in India, specializing in Node.js backend systems, Telegram bot development, REST API integrations, and payment verification systems. Available for freelance and contract work.

## About

I'm Mohit, a full stack developer building Telegram bots, APIs, websites, and backend systems with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Telegraf.

Through Coding With Mohit (CWM), I build practical projects and tools that solve real problems. My work includes Telegram bot automation, payment systems, API integrations, and database-driven backends.

I've built and deployed multiple live projects, including a payment platform (CWMPay) that processed 40,000+ worth of real transactions across 50-60 active merchants within its first two weeks. Working with real users has given me experience beyond just building projects locally — from handling production issues to improving systems based on actual usage.

Currently open to freelance and contract work.

## Services

### Telegram Bot Development
Custom Telegram bots built using Node.js and Telegraf, designed for real-world use cases such as automation, user management, payments, referrals, and integrations with third-party APIs.

### Payment Verification Systems
Backend systems that verify UPI, gateway, and crypto payments automatically — checking transaction status, amount, and reference before granting access or confirming an order, without relying on a full payment gateway.

### Website Development
Clean, responsive websites built with modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Focused on performance, clarity, and practical design rather than unnecessary visual clutter.

### Backend & API Integration
Server-side development for handling databases, authentication, APIs, and business logic. Systems built to be reliable, scalable, and easy to extend.

### Database Design & Management
Designing and managing databases using MongoDB and related tools to handle real user data, transactions, and application logic efficiently.

### Automation & Custom Tools
Custom scripts and tools to automate repetitive tasks, integrate services, and improve workflow efficiency for individuals and small teams.

## Projects

### CWMPay — Merchant Payment Verification Platform (Flagship Project)
Built a payment verification platform for small merchants in under two weeks, processing 40,000+ worth of real transactions across 50-60 active merchants. Included an API layer, merchant dashboard, and webhook system for real-time payment confirmation. After scaling, identified a regulatory gap in the fund-flow architecture and proactively paused onboarding to redesign it around a compliant, licensed payment-partner model rather than continuing to scale a flawed structure.

Tech: ReactJS, Tailwind, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST API, Webhooks
Use case: Real-time merchant payment verification and dashboard, built and battle-tested with real users and real transaction volume.
Live: https://cwmpay.in | Docs: https://docs.cwmpay.in | Status: https://status.cwmpay.in
Note: Currently paused, not onboarding new merchants, while the payment architecture is redesigned around a licensed partner model.

### BharatPe Payment Checker API
API to simplify payment verification without a gateway. Verifies payments using UTR from a BharatPe merchant account. Checks if a transaction exists and returns amount, reference number, date & time.

Tech: Node.js, Express.js, REST API
Use case: Verify BharatPe payments without a gateway
Live demo: https://bharatpe-payment-checker.vercel.app/

### Generate FIXED Amount UPI QR Code API
In bots and early-stage systems, users often send the wrong amount, causing refunds and manual hassle. This API generates fixed-amount UPI QR codes with UPI ID, name, exact amount, and transaction ID.

Tech: Node.js, Express.js, REST API
Use case: Generate fixed-amount UPI QR codes for seamless transactions
Live demo: https://payment-qr-generator-hazel.vercel.app/

### Crypto Transaction Verification API
A REST-based backend API that verifies cryptocurrency transactions by checking wallet address, transferred amount, and transaction status directly on the blockchain using explorer APIs like BscScan. Built for applications requiring automatic crypto payment verification before enabling features, activating services, or confirming deposits.

Tech: Node.js, BscScan API, REST API
Use case: Crypto payment verification, automated access control, transaction validation
Live demo: https://crypto-payment-api.vercel.app/

### Telegram Bot Broadcast & Automation System
A Telegram bot system designed to send broadcasts, manage users, and automate messaging workflows efficiently without violating Telegram limits.

Tech: Node.js, Telegram Bot API, MongoDB, REST API
Use case: Community management, announcements, automation
Live demo: https://broadcast-coding-with-mohits-projects.vercel.app/

### Telegram Channel Membership Verification API
A backend system that verifies whether a user is a member of a Telegram channel before granting access to protected features. Built for scalability and real-world usage.

Tech: Node.js, Telegram Bot API, MongoDB, REST API
Use case: Access control, paid communities, member verification
Live demo: https://verify-membership-coding-with-mohits-projects.vercel.app/verify-membership

### Custom Telegram Bots for Real Use Cases
Multiple custom bots built for tasks like referrals, user registration, balance systems, withdrawals, and API-based integrations.

Tech: Node.js, Telegraf, MongoDB, External APIs
Use case: Automation, payments, user management
Bots: Refer & Earn Bot (https://t.me/ReferEarnCWMBot), Truecaller Bot (https://t.me/TruecallerByMohitBot), Social Media Services Bot (https://t.me/CWMSocialMediaGrowthBot)

### Personal Brand Website (Coding With Mohit)
A clean, performance-focused personal brand website built to showcase projects, services, and learning resources around Telegram bot and web development.

Tech: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Responsive Design
Use case: Personal branding, portfolio, content hub
